classes.required: Lives in the host record and must come back unchanged through export and import.
classes.optional: The host may store it. If it does not, it lives in the sidecar. Either way it must round trip.
classes.sidecar_only: Working case state. Lives only in the sidecar, never in the host record.

schema_version.note: The adapter writes the case schema version it exports.

case_id.note: Stable case ID. The adapter keeps the same ID on every export.

revision.note: Changes only when the host record or the sidecar changes.

active_question_id.note: Points at a question in the sidecar.

authorization.note: What the user allowed in this working case.

checkpoint.note: Next action for the working case.

questions.note: Research questions of the working case.

hypotheses.note: Host stores them, or they go in the sidecar.

searches.note: Includes negative searches. Host or sidecar.

changes.note: Reread and correction history. Host or sidecar.

conclusions.evidence_assessment.note: Scoped assessment for source_supported. Host or sidecar, keyed by conclusion ID.

observations.reading_method.note: How the reading was made. Host or sidecar, keyed by observation ID.
